items.title: Eddie Locke interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, NY, January 13, 2001
items.q: It was the same school Bags went to, Milt Jackson went to that high school.

ctx.x: Was there people in your high school even?

Oh yeah. Because it was a big area, my high school, Miller High School, that’s where I went, to Miller High School. It was the same school Bags went to, Milt Jackson went to that high school. And Kenny Burrell went to it, Oliver Jackson. Of course Detroit was a big area. It was very spread out. There must have been seven, eight, nine high schools there. Of course Tommy Flanagan went to a different one, Roland Hanna. Roland Hanna and Tommy went to the same high school. Barry Harris went to a different high school.…
